descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S26 Slow and failed generation while the physician is away: a generating state while the call runs, the note or an explicit failure on return (both modes)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Generation runs on the server: the physician can tap Generate and move to another patient; the Post-Round tab shows a 'generating' state, and on return the note is there or an explicit failure shows, … (UAT TC-14; UAT 3.5; TFA-92592 AC 15) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • T8 If both models fail, a clear error shows and the dictation is not lost (Empty & Failure States: 'Note not generated' shown, dictation kept; … (TFA-94422 AC 5; UAT Empty & Failure States; UAT OAT-03)
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Fresh physician, two patients per mode as in S07. The runner controls the ai/notes:generateNote call: held about 15 s and then answered (cells H), or failed so that no model answers (cells F)

When Cell H, each mode: type the cell text, press Generate Note & Finish, open the second patient at once, return to the first within 2 s and open Post-Round; after the call is released, wait 5 s and look again. …

Then While the call is held, Post-Round shows a generating state, never only 'Complete the Encounter tab first' (UAT 3.5 and U4; OAT-03: the physician is never left waiting with nothing). After the release the note is there. When generation fails while the physician is away, on return an explicit failure shows and the dictation is on the Encounter tab

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint: the early checkpoint mustContainAny a generating marker ('Generating', 'Writing note') and mustNotContain 'Complete the Encounter tab first'; the late one carries the cell's blood pressure; the failure cells need an accepted failure string ('Note not generated', 'couldn’t be generated', 'could not be generated'; …

Where it ran: dev; test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
